$comment: Dependency-license policy for scripts/report-licenses.ts, implementing docs/LICENSING_POLICY.md §9. HowToBaby software is AGPL-3.0-only; dependencies are classified by SPDX id. 'allowed' needs no review; 'review' must have a reviewed[] decision before --strict passes; anything else (unknown/custom/unlisted) is a review-required finding. Never add an id to 'allowed' merely because installation succeeded.
